Return concise findings with line cites.
</user_query>
I'll inspect those three section components and how service pages use their heading props.
Section heading and shell are clear; locating the service page template next.

input.final_summary: SectionHeading only supports heading, subheading, headingId, inverted, and className — no eyebrow or align. Service body sections all use the same heading call shape (heading + headingId only). Section breaks are mainly muted/default tone plus shared py-12/sm:py-16 padding; content panels vary, but headings do not.
